task_summary: Configured ASDLC Multi-Scenario 3-Layer Task Architecture across CMS-V2 governance and cognitive runtime: Layer 1 (Harel statecharts with OR-superstates, AND-orthogonal parallel regions, deep/shallow history states), Layer 2 (Durable checkpoint engine persisting 6 tracking attributes to .agents/ptss/tasks/ and 2-step zero-delta circuit breaker), and Layer 3 (Topologically-sorted DAGs with Boolean guard reduction). Created asdlc-task-orchestrator skill, python runtime engine scripts/asdlc_task_orchestrator.py, and updated AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, and workspace-rules.md.
lessons_learned: Lesson: Flat text-based prompt checklists suffer from hallucinated progress and state explosion O(2^N) when managing multi-scenario edge cases.
Lesson learned: Decomposing execution into hierarchical statecharts with orthogonal regions keeps state bounds linear O(N) while verifying independent scenarios in parallel.

Prevention: Persisting scenario checkpoint state outside prompt memory in .agents/ptss/tasks/ with an explicit 2-step zero-delta circuit breaker prevents infinite agentic loops and ensures reliable resume from deep history H*.
